whatIs: GetLayers AI is a library of website templates, 3D scenes, gradients, sections and animated backgrounds that you copy as a prompt and paste into an AI like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot. Scenes and gradients are adjusted in the browser before copying, and the prompt carries your values.

By default the prompt generates a self-contained HTML file, but you can ask your AI to rebuild it in Next.js, Astro, Vue, WordPress and others. It's a good fit if you want a polished look without starting from a blank page.
uses: Paste a 3D scene prompt into your AI for a landing page hero.
Rebuild a site template in Astro or Next.js instead of plain HTML.
Apply a gradient or animated background tuned to your palette.
caveats: The free tier is a limited set of layers; the rest requires a paid plan, and the lower plans have a daily copy limit.
The result depends on the AI you use: review the code it generates and make sure it fits your stack.
Layers with 4K backgrounds, Figma designs or source code only come with the higher plans.
pricingNote: Free layers with the full prompt; paid plans start at $99 (annual or lifetime).
idealFor: Anyone who uses an AI assistant and wants to start from a polished visual base.
